summary: SEH/C++-exception wrapper around a wrapped CRT dispatch. Saves the dword preceding a2 and the two TLS slots 27/28 (via TLSValueRetrievalWithInit), installs a1 and a3 into those TLS slots, runs the wrapped body SEHExceptionFrameWrapper(a2, a4, a5, a6, a7), then restores all saved state. If the exception record behind a1 carries a C++ exception code (0xE06D7363 at +0x0), three parameters at +0x10 and magic 0x19930520 at +0x14, and the body returned non-zero, it checks CRTAbnormalTermination() and dispatches through SEHWrappedRenderDispatchCall(a1, abnormal). Returns the wrapped body's return value. Called by MultiArgRenderingDispatchWithLayout (00593839).
